title: Worst headache of her life
presenting_complaint: Sudden severe occipital headache peaking within a minute, started 2 hours ago at the gym, with vomiting.
history: Teacher. Headache "like being hit with a bat", vomited twice. No loss of consciousness, no seizure, no head trauma. Poorly controlled hypertension on amlodipine. Smoker. Mother died of a brain bleed at 52. Not on anticoagulants or antiplatelets.

findings.name: Non-contrast head CT
findings.value: Hyperdense blood in basal cisterns and Sylvian fissures

findings.name: CT angiography
findings.value: 7 mm aneurysm of the anterior communicating artery

diagnosis_options.label: Subarachnoid haemorrhage from ruptured anterior communicating artery aneurysm

management_options.label: Urgent neurosurgical / neurointerventional referral for aneurysm securing (coiling or clipping)
Control systolic BP below 160 mmHg with titratable IV agent
Lumbar puncture
management_options.explanation: Not needed after a diagnostic CT and risks rebleeding.
